children: Needham reiterated their Buy rating on QuickLogic's stock with a price target of $20.00.
The price target implies an upside of 86.6% from the Sep 18 close of $10.72.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: QuickLogic is transitioning from project-based development to a more productized model, which is expected to enhance revenue visibility and improve margins as customer evaluations translate into production programs.

: The company has maintained its guidance for 3Q26, projecting revenue of $5.5 million with a gross margin of 47%, alongside an optimistic long-term revenue growth outlook of 70-80% year-over-year for FY26, indicating strong operational momentum.
